description: Paths a loop session must never author (tier T8, docs/AUTONOMOUS-LOOP-POLICY.md section 3). Enforced in two places: scripts/loop/guard-edit.mjs blocks edits in loop sessions, and scripts/loop/forbidden-paths.mjs plus the trusted merge decision refuse any loop/ pull request that touches them. classify-risk.mjs builds its T8 rule from this list. Each pattern is a JavaScript regular expression matched against the repository-relative path.
